messages:
Ashley: Legal flagged customer tenant `tenant-7832` — they say ~1200 objects with default 90d TTL were removed ~30d after ingestion. Customer claims they set a preserve flag; audit export missing entries for 2024-09-12 to 2024-09-14. Can ops confirm whether a purge ran or if deletions were due to retention policy mis-eval?
Priya: Can you paste a sample object id and the policy settings? also need the account id and any correlate from the delete-worker logs.
Ashley: sample ids: obj_8f3a2, obj_8f3a3. Policy for tenant-7832 shows default_retention_days=90 and no custom policy. Legal says they requested a hold via PD portal on 2024-09-11 at 15:04 UTC — portal shows accepted.
Mike: I pulled the delete-worker logs for that window — seeing repeated KMS timeouts around 2024-09-12 15:10 UTC. snippet:```2024-09-12T15:10:12Z delete-worker[pid=321]: deleting object obj_8f3a2 -> encrypt_meta fetch failed: KMS_TIMEOUT (ctx=request_id=abc123)```
Mike: There's also a follow-up from the scheduler:```2024-09-12T15:10:20Z scheduler: tombstone created obj_8f3a2 (reason=delete_worker_retry_limit)```
Priya: If the delete worker couldn't fetch encryption metadata, the tombstoning path created a tombstone record. Normally tombstones are gated by preserve flag checks — if legal hold was applied before the tombstone, it should have prevented tombstone creation. Need portal audit events to confirm hold timestamp and operator id.
Ashley: Portal shows hold applied at 15:04 UTC by user `legal@cust.com`. ops-bot ticket: <https://incident-tracker/redwood/INC-4921> says KMS rotation completed at 15:05 UTC in us-west-2.
ops-bot: INC-4921 created by infra-deploy-bot — KMS rotation completed; post-rotation, HSM pool experienced transient rejects for ~7m. See infra note: https://runbook/internal/kms-rotation-2024-09-12
Legal: This is urgent — request immediate preservation for tenant-7832 and a signed statement of which objects were tombstoned and whether any purge occurred. We need a forensics export.
Mike: Steps I'm running: 1) lock purge job for tenant-7832 (pause queue) 2) export tombstone index slice for 2024-09-12..13 3) pull KMS audit events (rotation window) 4) run `SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE tenant='tenant-7832' AND ts BETWEEN '2024-09-12' AND '2024-09-13'` and attach.
Priya: Repro command to surface the delete-worker behavior locally (dev):```KMS_ENDPOINT=http://kms-stub:4566 ./delete-worker --tenant tenant-7832 --dry-run --start 2024-09-12T15:00:00Z --end 2024-09-12T15:30:00Z```
Mike: Found audit gap: export shard for 15:08-15:12 failed with 504 from logging-proxy. That aligns with KMS rejects. I am listing tombstones: obj_8f3a2, obj_8f3a3, obj_8f3b1... total tombstones 1,214. No purge records exist after 2024-09-12 in storage logs — blobs still in cold storage buckets, but index moved them to tombstoned state.
Ashley: So customer sees objects "deleted" from search because index hides tombstoned items; physically data still present. Need to explain to legal and customer and rehydrate visibility.
Legal: Ok — we need: (A) confirmation no physical purge occurred, (B) timestamps of tombstone creation, (C) KMS error codes and operator actions, (D) immediate stop of any scheduled purges until legal confirms.
Priya: I've locked the purge queue for tenant-7832 and requested SRE to snapshot the storage buckets (ticket INC-4923). Mike, can you collate the tombstone index CSV and KMS audit slice and drop into the incident ticket?
Mike: On it. attaching `tombstones_tenant-7832_20240912.csv` and `kms-audit-20240912.json` to INC-4921. Also adding a short mitigation: revert last rotation in staging and add backoff to deletion path so KMS transient rejects don't auto-tombstone.
Ashley: I'll update customer with a short note: we are investigating, no purges completed, preserve flag honored moving forward, and we will share full audit artifacts within 24h. :white_check_mark:
Legal: Please include a signed cover note from infra confirming snapshot and that no purge completed.
Mike: We'll have the artifacts in the ticket within 6 hours. If anyone needs exec-ready wording I can draft.
ops-bot: INC-4921 updated by Mike — artifacts uploaded.
Ashley: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: Priya to confirm portal hold records, SRE to confirm bucket snapshot, Mike to propose small runtime change to prevent tombstone-on-kms-failure.
Priya: noted, will post update once I validate portal logs. :memo:
